verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official Drata MCP server documented in Drata's help center (help.drata.com article 13379899). The developer portal also explicitly offers to 'Enable AI agents to interact with Drata' to automate compliance workflows and manage controls through natural language. Drata is a SaaS compliance platform, not an agent, so this server axis applies and is directly evidenced; the GitHub 'drata-agent' is a device-monitoring app and is irrelevant here. missing for 10: details of the exposed tools/scope, setup and auth instructions (transport, OAuth/API key), and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.
